questions.answer: An MCP server is the piece that lets an AI application such as Claude connect to outside tools and data. It can let Claude read from a database, query an analytics account or take an action in another system [1]. The Model Context Protocol is an open standard for this kind of connection, and with an MCP server Claude can read your CRM or reporting data within limits you set, usually read-only to start [2]. Joe mostly builds with Claude and MCP [3]. For a project, see [/contact/](/contact/).
